request.style: English, female solo voice, ethereal, piano, strings, soft drums, atmospheric, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
An hour is coming, it is now here
You will worship the Father, not on this mountain
Nor in Jerusalem, but in a new way
Believe me, woman, the time has arrived

[Chorus]
Worship in spirit and truth
The Father seeks such people
God is spirit, we must worship him
In spirit and truth, in spirit and truth

[Verse]
You worship what you do not know
We worship what we know, salvation is from the Jews
But the true worshipers will worship the Father
In spirit and truth, seeking such people

[Chorus]
Worship in spirit and truth
The Father seeks such people
God is spirit, we must worship him
In spirit and truth, in spirit and truth

[Bridge]
I know that Messiah is coming
He who is called Christ, he will tell us everything
Jesus said to her, I am he
I who am speaking to you, right now

[Chorus]
Worship in spirit and truth
The Father seeks such people
God is spirit, we must worship him
In spirit and truth, in spirit and truth

[Outro]
Disciples came back, astonished at his words
No one asked, why are you talking with her
Worship in spirit and truth
